tasks.short: Observe patient progress and maintain client records

steps.what: Observe and capture patients' progress, attitudes, and behaviour during therapy
Write a progress note from the assistant's observations and patient statements

loop.purpose: Organise the assistant's captured account into a draft progress note
loop.input: session observations, patient statements, treatment goals
loop.output: progress note draft separating reported and observed information
loop.check: Assistant checks factual accuracy, attribution, change from baseline, uncertainty, and absence of inferred attitudes or diagnoses
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; missing or ambiguous observations require a manual note
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text observations need semantic organisation, while a structured form remains the first alternative

steps.what: Verify the progress note and save the authorised client-record version

tasks.design: Retain observation and source capture with the assistant. In the clinical record system {OTHER}, a bounded draft organises that account; the assistant verifies and saves within existing permissions, retaining any required therapist review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Note composition repeats an account already captured during care but can distort clinical meaning.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-constrained drafting step can produce an editable note without interpreting patient behaviour independently.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing observation, patient report, and clinical interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant notices meaningful change and knows when the therapist must be consulted.
tasks.altitude: A modest reduction in note wording leaves time for verification; clinical decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Flag an observed change needing therapist review
reach.learn: Escalation criteria and professional documentation boundaries

evidence.claim: Intramed Fysio.AI drafts structured physiotherapy intake reports and asks the therapist to check and correct them; this does not establish occupational therapy progress-note performance.
Applying a reviewed draft to assistant progress notes is an E1 design hypothesis with no measured time saving here.

assumptions: Boundary is assistant observation and record maintenance, excluding treatment delivery and therapist clinical decisions. OTHER is the clinical record system.

Assistant captures patient and session identifiers, activity, observed performance, patient statements, assistance required, and uncertainty during s1. Capture time remains in s1; absent details are not inferred. Manual structured entry is the fallback.
Test native note templates and dictation before a model loop. No automatic emotion inference, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation is introduced.

Existing therapist review requirements remain unchanged outside the assistant denominator; no newly transferred review work is assumed. If extra therapist review is required, measure and budget it before adoption.
research_questions: Does independent review find altered meaning, omitted uncertainty, or invented observations in progress-note drafts?

already_counted.description: Verify the note and save the authorised record version

incremental.description: Maintain note instructions and investigate recurrent drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact note text, patient and session identifiers, attachments and record destination; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88; gross 12 minus 5 upkeep gives net 7. Range assumes source observations already captured reliably; complex or ambiguous sessions may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select therapy activities for patient needs and capabilities

steps.what: Select therapy activities within the care plan to fit patient needs and capabilities

tasks.design: Retain activity selection with the assistant within the authorised care plan. Existing clinical information in {OTHER} supports judgement, and uncertainty goes to the occupational therapist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitable activities depend on fluctuating capabilities and patient response.
tasks.enabler_now: No automated clinical selection is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing challenge, fatigue, safety, and the patient's goals.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant adapts to the person and recognises limits of delegated authority.

reach.task: Describe a capability change affecting planned activities

evidence.claim: Patient-specific activity selection remains contextual human judgement; no saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is activity selection within delegated authority, excluding therapist care-plan creation and activity delivery.

Therapist produces the existing authorised care plan before selection; assistant observes current capabilities during s1. OTHER is the clinical record system. No new structured feed or model-based treatment recommendation is required.
Existing native record access suffices; unchanged practice adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which observed changes require therapist review before choosing an activity?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero because activity-selection judgement remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Attend continuing education classes and practise the taught knowledge or skills

tasks.design: Retain actual class attendance, questions, and practice. An existing {LMS} provides course materials, without treating automated completion records as a substitute for learning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Competence requires engagement and practice rather than access to a summary.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement for class participation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Applying general instruction to patients within the assistant's scope.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant tests understanding and asks about uncertain situations.

reach.task: Discuss whether a new technique fits local practice
reach.learn: Reflective learning and supervised skill validation

evidence.claim: Attending professional education and practising skills remain human effort; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is attendance and learning, excluding separate booking and certificate administration.
Course provider supplies instruction and exercises during the class; no structured data contract or new capture process is introduced.
Existing native learning tools remain sufficient; unchanged participation requires zero additional upkeep.
research_questions: Can participants demonstrate the skill after class under appropriate supervision?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving zero. Actual learning participation stays unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate and collaborate with patient-care professionals

steps.what: Communicate observations and collaborate with healthcare professionals on the patient's care

tasks.design: Keep care-team discussion and clarification with the assistant and responsible professionals. Verified observations in the clinical record system {OTHER} inform the conversation without replacing clinical judgement or accountable handover.
tasks.previous_blocker: A record alone does not establish shared understanding of a care concern.
tasks.enabler_now: No automated substitute for collaborative discussion is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling differing observations and recognising when authority is needed.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant can explain uncertainty and confirm that the receiving professional understands it.

reach.task: Clarify the owner of an agreed follow-up action

evidence.claim: Patient-care collaboration requires contextual communication; no saving is assumed for the unchanged discussion.

assumptions: Boundary covers the assistant's professional discussion, excluding record creation counted in the observation task and other professionals' own care decisions.

Assistant and care professionals produce existing verified observations and care-plan information through their usual work before discussion. OTHER is the clinical record system. No new structured handover feed or capture requirement is imposed.
Native record sharing remains sufficient; an unchanged process adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Do recipients understand the observation, uncertainty, and owner of the next action?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving zero. Care-team collaboration remains direct human work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant may spend less time composing progress notes while retaining observation, activity selection, learning, and care collaboration.
role.ambitious_version: An assistant who documents observations accurately and gives more attention to patient-specific support.
